sites.note: GDD 7.3: bedroom about 1 kW, garage about 10 kW, leased warehouse about 500 kW from Act 2 (GDD 6 lists it as an Act 2 unlock; it needs incorporation). $0.115/kWh is close to the 2010 US residential average and $0.10 to the commercial average; one rate per site until regions arrive. The garage has fans (PUE 1.05), the warehouse more cooling (PUE 1.1).
